name: rocky
description: rocky Claude Code plugin (Bun runtime). worklog_* tools (append-only local JSONL agent journal — the record layer; always registered). A Stop hook auto-captures each turn as a kind:"turn" worklog entry — the plugin's only hook. Slash commands: /rocky:brainstorm (shape an idea into a design — context first, one question at a time, 2-3 approaches; a tool, not a gate), /rocky:review (dispatch the reviewer subagent to review the current working diff before claiming done), /rocky:finish (gates → commit → push → PR, gh CLI), /rocky:resolve-reviews (resolve the reviews already on a PR — fixes what needs no caller judgment, leaves anything the caller must decide open and reports it in chat; 👀 reaction only, no comments or resolves unless told; never merges, gh CLI), /rocky:recall (distills the worklog into an anchored history digest — the organize layer). Bundled skills: writing-cc-plugin (Claude Code plugin authoring guide + reference). Bundled subagents: reviewer (read-only fresh-context review of a diff against its requirements — dispatched by /rocky:review, also callable directly; never edits, never merges). The rocky-todo shared board daemon lives in its own plugin/repo (minjun0219/rocky-todo). Removed and recoverable from git history: openapi_* / seo_validate / notion_* (v0.23, zero usage), souls / statusline / the opencode delegation runtime / the /rocky:codex and /rocky:issue commands / the todoist skill. rocky integrates with no external task service — the task list is the rocky-todo board, the record is worklog_*.
